interactive.label: 📂 Open folder…
interactive.tooltip: Choose a folder of .cor (or legacy .json.gz) correlation curves; dropping the folder on the window does the same.

interactive.label: 🧹 Clear
interactive.tooltip: Remove every curve and the merge (the files stay on disk).

interactive.label: 📖 Guide
interactive.tooltip: Walk through screening the repeats and saving the merge.

interactive.label: ❓ Help
interactive.tooltip: Why repeats are screened before averaging, and what the merge assumes.

interactive.label: folder
interactive.tooltip: The folder whose curves are listed; type a path and press Enter, or drop a folder.

interactive.label: output
interactive.tooltip: The merged curve's file (Kristine .cor: lag, G, duration and count rate, standard error); the folder's name beside the folder by default.

interactive.label: 💾 Save
interactive.tooltip: Write the merge of the ticked curves to the target file.

interactive.label: Save as…
interactive.tooltip: Choose another target file and write the merge there.

interactive.label: 🚀 Add to ChiSurf
interactive.tooltip: Save the merge and add it to ChiSurf as an FCS dataset (Seidel Kristine).
